## Incident Overview

The test test_plugin_json_agents_in_sync fails because plugin.json agents list is out of sync with the agents/ directory. This blocks version-bump PRs (observed on PRs #373, #376). Pre-existing infrastructure issue.

**Impact**: Version-bump PRs fail Script Tests check
data.title: ci: test_plugin_json_agents_in_sync fails -> version-bump PRs blocked
